# Feathery

Feathery is an AI-powered data intake workflow platform that enables users to build customizable forms with advanced logic and integrations.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/feathery/.

## Actions

- **Create or Fetch User**: Create a new user or fetch an existing one.
- **Edit Feathery Account**: Edit an existing account’s role and permissions.
- **Fill or sign document template**: Fill or sign a Feathery document template.
- **Generate Workspace Login Token**: Generate a login JWT for a workspace.
- **Get Account Info** (read-only): Get your Feathery team name and list of accounts.
- **Get All User Data** (read-only): Retrieve all stored data fields for a user.
- **Get User Session** (read-only): Get a user's form session and progress.
- **List Forms** (read-only): List all forms in your Feathery account.
- **Create hidden field**: Create a new hidden field in a form.
- **Delete Form**: Delete an existing form.
- **Delete User**: Delete a specific user by ID.
- **Get form schema** (read-only): Retrieve the schema of a specific form.
- **List API Connector Errors** (read-only): List recent API connector error logs for a form.
- **List Document Envelopes** (read-only): List generated document envelopes by document or user ID.
- **List Email Issues** (read-only): List email bounce and complaint events.
- **List Email Logs** (read-only): List recently sent emails for a form.
- **List Hidden Fields** (read-only): List all hidden form fields in the account.
- **List Quik Request Logs** (read-only): List recent Quik integration request logs for a form.
- **List Users** (read-only): List all users in your Feathery account.
